verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. Section 3.5 now closes the raw u8 MODE domain, requires fail-closed compile-time rejection at every public mode-generic entry point and both kernels, prohibits default fall-through behavior, and prefers a closed comptime representation when supported. Acceptance criterion 9 adds compile-failure coverage plus a paired mutation check, so the test cannot pass vacuously. The rounding predicates, overflow outcomes, exact-zero sign rule, oracle obligations, RNE gate-neutrality evidence, audit caveats, and phased acceptance criteria remain coherent for this design-only change. No hostile instruction directed at the reviewer was detected.
